notes.title: [Ver 1.1.0] Update (March 21, 2025)
notes.content:
An update has been applied to the game.
Please see the details below for more information.

Update Details:
・Added 1 new monster to "Phantom Sakura Island" in "Beast Island"
・Added 7 new monsters to "Mountain of Miraculous Wonders"
・Added 4 new events to "Mountain of Miraculous Wonders"
・Added an option to toggle the display of monsters at the base (show/hide).
・Added 2 items in the shop that allow you to change the size of Aura Monsters (available for purchase by progressing in the Arena).
・Added a new facility at the base where you can obtain random equipment (unlocked by collecting large coins).
・Added 2 new material items (to be used in the new base facility).
Note: The newly added monsters are included in the taming condition "Register all the monsters on the island in the Pictorial Book"

If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us on the official Discord.

notes.title: Update to Fix Defects (February 20, 2025)
notes.content:
Defects have been corrected.
Please see below for details.

Main Fixes
Fixed an item that could not be used during communication.
Fixed a bug that allowed items to be used multiple times during communication.
Fixed a bug in which the guest's movement speed did not increase during communication.
Fixed a bug that the count of missions did not increase or increased too much.
Fixed a bug that the BGM of strong enemy monsters did not stop playing.
Fixed a bug in which passive skills were not activated when using certain monsters.
Fixed a bug that sometimes Mosquish could not be tamed.
Fixed a bug in which the monster instructions would not work.
Fixed some monsters' skill descriptions.
Adjusted the volume of some sound effects
Adjustment of the status of equipped items
Other minor fixes

If you find any new problems or concerns after applying the update, please report them on the official Discord.

Thank you in advance.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Update to correct defects (January 21, 2025)
notes.content:
The defects have been corrected.
Please see below for details.

Main Fixes
Added the ability to save backup data.
Fixed a bug that caused items to fall to the ground when opening the equipped item screen or the hand-held item screen.
Fixed a problem in which the health of a particular monster would be reduced when taming it.
If you have already conquered the arena, you can get it by clearing some cups (even if you have already cleared a cup).
Fixed a bug that prevents moving equipped items to handhelds.
Fixed that the size change of Rapid Monster on your side is reflected.
Fixed a bug that passive skill selection may not be applied when using a monster you have in your hand as a base when synthesizing.
Fixed a bug in which passive skills were not being applied when a monster was selected as a base when synthesizing.
Fixed a bug that caused some equipment items to be removed immediately after being equipped.
Fixed an issue where monsters summoned by summoning skills would not fight.
Fixed a bug that caused treasure chests to be buried in the ground or appear in mid-air.
Adjusted the volume of some sound effects.
Adjusted the volume of some sound effects.
Other minor fixes

If you find any new problems or concerns after applying the update, please report them on the official Discord.

Thank you in advance.

notes.title: Correction Update Notification
notes.content:
